description:
CDS Global is undertaking a significant transformation of its platforms, engineering practices, operating model and use of artificial intelligence. CDS Global seeks an exceptional executive to lead Engineering, Architecture, Technology Modernization and Applied AI while serving as a strategic partner to Product, Commercial and Client leaders. The successful executive will combine deep software and platform credibility with enterprise transformation experience. This person will determine how CDS Global stabilizes, modernizes, integrates, re-platforms, replaces or retires capabilities while protecting service continuity, client commitments, security and trust. This is a builder mandate. The executive must create the engineering system, leadership depth, partner ecosystem and AI-enabled practices required to turn product direction and client needs into scalable, reliable and economically responsible outcomes.

 Engineering Organization & Delivery

 
 Builds a high-performing engineering organization with clear ownership, standards and measurable outcomes.

 Transforms Engineering from a capacity- and project-oriented delivery model toward an increasingly platform-oriented operating model characterized by durable ownership, reusable capabilities, measurable engineering effectiveness and clear accountability for production outcomes.

 Improves delivery predictability, engineering capacity transparency, quality, reliability, security and developer effectiveness.

 Balances client commitments, roadmap delivery, platform investment, maintenance, technical debt, modernization and innovation.

 Reduces dependence on individual knowledge holders through architecture, documentation, leadership development and succession.

 
 Architecture & Modernization

 
 Sets coherent architectural direction across platforms, cloud, APIs, integration, data, event-driven systems and observability.

 Creates a sequenced modernization roadmap for business-critical legacy platforms.

 Uses pilots and proofs of concept to answer explicit investment questions with entry, exit, scale and stop criteria.

 Protects continuity, controls and client trust while reducing fragility, complexity, technical debt and scarce-skill dependency.

 
 Applied AI & AI-Augmented Engineering

 
 Defines a focused applied-AI portfolio tied to product, engineering and operating outcomes.

 Establishes measurable AI value criteria, including adoption, quality, productivity, revenue enablement, cost-to-serve, client value and operating capacity, and recommends when initiatives should scale, change direction or stop.

 Moves selected use cases from discovery to pilot, production and scaled adoption.

 Uses AI responsibly across code understanding, development, testing, documentation, migration, workflow automation and client-facing capabilities.

 Establishes evaluation, monitoring, security, data, privacy, human-review and accountability practices with appropriate enterprise partners.

 
 Product, Client & Commercial Partnership

 
 Partners with Product to translate market and client needs into scalable capabilities, coherent roadmaps and sound technical choices.

 Engages strategic clients and partners where architecture, integrations, modernization, data or AI are material.

 Ensures commitments are technically supportable, economically responsible and aligned with platform direction.

 Brings engineering evidence, capacity, risk and economics into product lifecycle and portfolio decisions.

 
 Investment, Partners & Governance

 
 Owns Engineering and Technology budgets, workforce planning, material vendors and strategic investment recommendations.

 Creates transparent governance across engineering, modernization and AI investments, and provides executive oversight of the technology responsibilities within the enterprise compliance and assurance program, including Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance and applicable System and Organization Controls (SOC 1 and SOC 2) examinations. In partnership with Security, Compliance, Finance, Legal and control owners, establishes clear responsibilities, a coordinated assessment calendar, ongoing control monitoring, evidence readiness and timely remediation of findings. Escalates material gaps, overdue actions and resource needs to the President.

 Leads build-buy-partner-integrate-orchestrate decisions and manages dependency risk.

 Measures progress through enterprise outcomes rather than activity or pilot volume.

 
 Talent & Transformation

 
 Assesses and evolves the organization, leadership structure, skills, decision rights and ways of working.

 Recruits and develops Engineering, Architecture, Platform and AI leaders.

 Builds technical career paths and succession depth across distributed teams.

 Leads change with urgency, candor, humility and respect for institutional knowledge.

 Fosters a culture of accountability, collaboration, sound decision-making, continuous improvement, innovation and client-focused execution.

 
 General

 
 Maintains confidentiality of CDS Global and its clients' proprietary information.

 Adheres to company policies regarding confidential information.

 Travels on behalf of CDS Global when required or requested.

 Performs additional duties as required or requested.

 
 Qualifications

 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, computer engineering or a related field. Master’s degree preferred. Relevant education and/or experience may be substituted for the minimum education requirement.

 Ten or more years of progressively responsible Engineering or Technology leadership experience, including leadership of complex software, platform or technology organizations and accountability for significant organizational transformation.

 Engineering leadership at scale: Has led a substantial software, platform or engineering organization and established strong practices across architecture, development, testing, DevSecOps, observability, reliability, documentation and production support.

 Enterprise transformation leadership: Has redesigned operating models, decision rights, talent capabilities, organizational structures and ways of working, rather than simply managing an established function.

 Complex platform modernization: Has modernized business-critical or legacy technology while protecting service continuity, client commitments, controls and enterprise trust. Can make explicit choices about what to stabilize, encapsulate, integrate, re-platform, replace or retire.

 Architecture and platform judgment: Can set coherent architectural direction across cloud, APIs, integration, data, platform engineering and security, while avoiding unnecessary rewrites, brittle dependencies or technology-led decisions disconnected from business outcomes.

 Applied and production AI: Has moved AI beyond experimentation into production products, engineering workflows or operating processes, with evidence of adoption, quality, controls and measurable business impact. No minimum number of years in AI is required.

 AI-augmented engineering: Has incorporated AI into the software-development lifecycle, potentially including code understanding, requirements, prototyping, development, testing, documentation, migration and developer productivity, with appropriate human review and quality controls.

 Product partnership and customer orientation: Has demonstrated a substantive working relationship with a Product development function or team or has directly owned such a function or team. Has worked with Product leaders, clients and business stakeholders to gather and clarify requirements, iteratively develop and validate solution options and translate customer and market needs into scalable capabilities, roadmap choices and technical investment decisions. Has partnered with Product, Finance and business leaders to develop return on investment (ROI) business cases addressing expected benefits, development and ongoing operating costs, assumptions, risks and investment trade-offs. Has then stewarded approved initiatives through Engineering, aligning architecture, capacity, delivery sequencing, quality and production readiness with the agreed requirements and business case. Must distinguish reusable product value from one-off customization and demonstrate how feedback and delivery results informed subsequent decisions. Company-wide Product leadership is not required; Product strategy and product-management accountability remain distinct from this role.

 Commercial and financial acumen: Understands recurring-revenue economics and how engineering and technology choices affect revenue, margin, retention, implementation effort, cost to serve and enterprise value. Has managed meaningful budgets, workforce plans, partners and investment trade-offs.

 Build-buy-partner judgment: Has demonstrated judgment to build, buy, partner, integrate, orchestrate, encapsulate or retire capabilities and understands the strategic and economic consequences of vendor and platform dependency.

 Risk, security and responsible technology leadership: Has operated where cybersecurity, privacy, data stewardship, operational resilience, regulatory obligations and responsible AI materially influenced technology decisions.

 Has led Engineering and Technology participation in material security, compliance and assurance programs, preferably including PCI DSS and SOC 1/SOC 2 Type 2 examinations, including scope management, control implementation and operation, evidence collection, assessor and auditor engagement and remediation of findings. Can demonstrate sustained control effectiveness between assessments and explain personal accountability, cross-functional governance and how modernization preserved compliance and assurance coverage.

 Client and external credibility: Can engage enterprise clients, prospects, strategic partners and senior operators; translate technology into differentiated and supportable value; and prevent technically or economically unsound commitments.

 People and leadership builder: Has recruited, developed and retained senior Engineering, Architecture, Platform and AI leaders; built succession depth; and created an accountable, collaborative and low-ego culture across distributed teams.

 
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel assigned to this job. 

 Benefits

 CDS Global offers a competitive benefits package to eligible employees, including:

 
 Health coverage: Two medical plan options—High Deductible and Traditional—plus comprehensive dental and vision plans.

 Time off and protection: Generous PTO, holiday pay, basic and voluntary life insurance, AD&D insurance, and short-term and long-term disability coverage.

 Retirement: A 401(k) retirement savings plan that allows employees to begin contributing immediately and includes a company match based on a percentage of employee contributions.

 Wellness and development: Wellness and tuition reimbursement programs.

 Family support: Paid parental leave for new parents.

 Child and dependent care: Up to $750 per month in reimbursement for qualified child and dependent care expenses.

 
 Additional Information

 Post-offer, pre-employment background checks are conducted on qualified candidates. Pre-employment drug and/or health screenings may be required for some positions.

 If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be just the right fit.
